+
+Token = tuple[str, str]
+
+
+def tokenize(src: str) -> list[Token]:
+    out: list[Token] = []
+    i = 0
+    while i < len(src):
+        ch = src[i]
+        if ch.isspace():
+            i += 1
+            continue
+        if ch == '"':
+            j = i + 1
+            s = ""
+            while j < len(src):
+                if src[j] == '"':
+                    if j + 1 < len(src) and src[j + 1] == '"':
+                        s += '"'; j += 2; continue
+                    break
+                s += src[j]; j += 1
+            if j >= len(src):
+                raise ParseError("unterminated string")
+            out.append(("STR", s)); i = j + 1; continue
+        if ch in ",:()&+-*/^%":
+            out.append((ch, ch)); i += 1; continue
+        if ch in "<>=":
+            if i + 1 < len(src) and src[i:i+2] in ("<=", ">=", "<>"):
+                out.append(("OP", src[i:i+2])); i += 2
+            else:
+                out.append(("OP", ch)); i += 1
+            continue
+        if ch == "'":
+            j = src.find("'!", i)
+            if j == -1:
+                raise ParseError("bad sheet quote")
+            out.append(("ID", src[i+1:j])); out.append(("!", "!")); i = j + 2; continue
+        m = re.match(r"\d+(\.\d*)?|\.\d+", src[i:])
+        if m:
+            out.append(("NUM", m.group(0))); i += len(m.group(0)); continue
+        m = re.match(r"\$?[A-Za-z]{1,3}\$?\d+|[A-Za-z_\\][A-Za-z0-9_.\\]*", src[i:])
+        if m:
+            out.append(("ID", m.group(0))); i += len(m.group(0)); continue
+        if ch == "!":
+            out.append(("!", "!")); i += 1; continue
+        raise ParseError(f"unexpected {ch}")
+    out.append(("EOF", ""))
+    return out
+
+
+class Parser:
+    def __init__(self, src: str):
+        self.tokens = tokenize(src)
+        self.i = 0
+
+    def peek(self) -> Token:
+        return self.tokens[self.i]
+
+    def pop(self, typ: str | None = None) -> Token:
+        tok = self.peek()
+        if typ and tok[0] != typ and tok[1] != typ:
+            raise ParseError(f"expected {typ}, got {tok}")
+        self.i += 1
+        return tok
+
+    def parse(self) -> Any:
+        expr = self.expr(0)
+        if self.peek()[0] != "EOF":
+            raise ParseError("trailing input")
+        return expr
+
+    def expr(self, minp: int) -> Any:
+        node = self.prefix()
+        while True:
+            tok = self.peek()
+            op = tok[1]
+            if tok[0] == "%":
+                self.pop(); node = ("pct", node); continue
+            if tok[0] == "(":
+                args = self.args()
+                node = ("call_expr", node, args); continue
+            prec = {"OP": 1, "&": 2, "+": 3, "-": 3, "*": 4, "/": 4, "^": 5}.get(tok[0])
+            if prec is None or prec < minp:
+                break
+            self.pop()
+            rhs = self.expr(prec + (0 if op == "^" else 1))
+            node = ("bin", op, node, rhs)
+        return node
+
+    def prefix(self) -> Any:
+        tok = self.peek()
+        if tok[0] == "NUM":
+            self.pop(); return ("num", float(tok[1]) if "." in tok[1] else int(tok[1]))
+        if tok[0] == "STR":
+            self.pop(); return ("str", tok[1])
+        if tok[0] in ("+", "-"):
+            self.pop(); return ("un", tok[0], self.expr(6))
+        if tok[0] == "(":
+            self.pop("("); node = self.expr(0); self.pop(")"); return node
+        if tok[0] == "ID":
+            return self.identish()
+        raise ParseError(f"unexpected token {tok}")
+
+    def identish(self) -> Any:
+        first = self.pop("ID")[1]
+        sheet = None
+        name = first
+        if self.peek()[0] == "!":
+            self.pop("!")
+            sheet = first
+            name = self.pop("ID")[1]
+        # Cell or range.
+        if re.fullmatch(r"\$?[A-Za-z]{1,3}\$?\d+", name):
+            start = name
+            if self.peek()[0] == ":":
+                self.pop(":")
+                end = self.pop("ID")[1]
+                return ("range", sheet, start, end)
+            return ("cell", sheet, start)
+        if self.peek()[0] == "(":
+            return ("call", first.upper(), self.args())
+        if name.upper() == "TRUE":
+            return ("bool", True)
+        if name.upper() == "FALSE":
+            return ("bool", False)
+        return ("name", name)
+
+    def args(self) -> list[Any]:
+        self.pop("(")
+        args = []
+        if self.peek()[0] != ")":
+            while True:
+                args.append(self.expr(0))
+                if self.peek()[0] != ",":
+                    break
+                self.pop(",")
+        self.pop(")")
+        return args
+
+
+def crit_match(v: Any, crit: Any) -> bool:
+    c = str(scalar(crit))
+    val = scalar(v)
+    m = re.match(r"^(>=|<=|<>|>|<|=)(.*)$", c)
+    if m:
+        op, rhs = m.group(1), m.group(2)
+        rv = parse_literal(rhs)
+        try:
+            a = num(val); b = num(rv)
+        except Exception:
+            a = str(val); b = str(rv)
+        return {"=": a == b, "<>": a != b, ">": a > b, "<": a < b, ">=": a >= b, "<=": a <= b}[op]
+    if "*" in c or "?" in c:
+        return re.fullmatch(re.escape(c).replace("\\*", ".*").replace("\\?", "."), str(val), re.I) is not None
+    return str(val).lower() == c.lower()
+
+
+def apply_elem(a: Any, b: Any, fn: Callable[[Any, Any], Any]) -> Any:
+    if is_array(a) or is_array(b):
+        am, bm = to_matrix(a), to_matrix(b)
+        rows, cols = max(len(am), len(bm)), max(len(am[0]) if am else 1, len(bm[0]) if bm else 1)
+        return [[fn(am[r % len(am)][c % len(am[0])], bm[r % len(bm)][c % len(bm[0])]) for c in range(cols)] for r in range(rows)]
+    return fn(a, b)
+
+
+class LambdaVal:
+    def __init__(self, params: list[str], body: Any, env: dict[str, Any]):
+        self.params = [p.upper() for p in params]
+        self.body = body
+        self.env = dict(env)
+
+
+class Engine:
+    def __init__(self, wb: dict[str, Any]):
+        self.wb = wb
+        self.ast_cache: dict[str, Any] = {}
+        self.visiting: list[tuple[str, str]] = []
+        self.circ: set[tuple[str, str]] = set()
+
+    def cell_map(self, sheet: str) -> dict[str, dict[str, Any]]:
+        return self.wb["sheet_data"][sheet]["cells"]
+
+    def parse_formula(self, formula: str) -> Any:
+        key = formula
+        if key not in self.ast_cache:
+            self.ast_cache[key] = Parser(formula[1:] if formula.startswith("=") else formula).parse()
+        return self.ast_cache[key]
+
+    def get_cell_value(self, sheet: str, ref: str, env: dict[str, Any] | None = None) -> Any:
+        ref = ref.replace("$", "").upper()
+        cm = self.cell_map(sheet)
+        cell = cm.get(ref)
+        if not cell:
+            return None
+        if cell.get("kind") == "spill":
+            return cell.get("value")
+        inp = cell.get("input")
+        if isinstance(inp, str) and inp.startswith("="):
+            key = (sheet, ref)
+            if self.wb.get("settings", {}).get("iterative_calc", {}).get("enabled"):
+                return cell.get("value")
+            if key in self.visiting:
+                self.circ.update(self.visiting[self.visiting.index(key):])
+                return "#CIRC!"
+            self.visiting.append(key)
+            try:
+                v = self.eval(self.parse_formula(inp), sheet, env or {})
+                cell["value"] = scalar(v) if is_array(v) else v
+                cell["kind"] = kind_value(cell["value"])
+                return cell["value"]
+            except Exception:
+                cell["value"] = "#NAME?"; cell["kind"] = "error"; return "#NAME?"
+            finally:
+                self.visiting.pop()
+        return cell.get("value")
+
+    def eval(self, node: Any, sheet: str, env: dict[str, Any]) -> Any:
+        t = node[0]
+        if t in ("num", "str", "bool"):
+            return node[1]
+        if t == "pct":
+            return num(self.eval(node[1], sheet, env)) / 100
+        if t == "un":
+            v = self.eval(node[2], sheet, env)
+            if is_error(v): return v
+            return clean_number(num(v) if node[1] == "+" else -num(v))
+        if t == "name":
+            nm = node[1].upper()
+            if nm in env:
+                return env[nm]
+            target = self.resolve_name(node[1], sheet)
+            if target:
+                sh, rng = target
+                return self.range_values(sh, rng)
+            return "#NAME?"
+        if t == "cell":
+            sh = node[1] or sheet
+            return self.get_cell_value(sh, node[2], env)
+        if t == "range":
+            sh = node[1] or sheet
+            return self.range_values(sh, f"{node[2]}:{node[3]}")
+        if t == "bin":
+            return self.binop(node[1], self.eval(node[2], sheet, env), self.eval(node[3], sheet, env))
+        if t == "call":
+            return self.call(node[1], node[2], sheet, env)
+        if t == "call_expr":
+            f = self.eval(node[1], sheet, env)
+            args = [self.eval(a, sheet, env) for a in node[2]]
+            return self.apply_lambda(f, args, sheet)
+        raise ValueError(node)
+
+    def resolve_name(self, name: str, sheet: str) -> tuple[str, str] | None:
+        for n in self.wb.get("names", []):
+            if n["name"].upper() == name.upper() and (n.get("scope") == "workbook" or n.get("sheet") == sheet):
+                sh, rng = parse_a1(n["range"], sheet)
+                return sh or sheet, rng
+        return None
+
+    def range_values(self, sheet: str, rng: str) -> list[list[Any]]:
+        r1, c1, r2, c2 = range_bounds(rng)
+        return [[self.get_cell_value(sheet, make_ref(r, c)) for c in range(c1, c2 + 1)] for r in range(r1, r2 + 1)]
+
+    def binop(self, op: str, a: Any, b: Any) -> Any:
+        if is_error(a): return a
+        if is_error(b): return b
+        def one(x, y):
+            try:
+                if op == "+": return clean_number(num(x) + num(y))
+                if op == "-": return clean_number(num(x) - num(y))
+                if op == "*": return clean_number(num(x) * num(y))
+                if op == "/":
+                    yy = num(y)
+                    return "#DIV/0!" if yy == 0 else clean_number(num(x) / yy)
+                if op == "^": return clean_number(num(x) ** num(y))
+                if op == "&": return f"{'' if x is None else x}{'' if y is None else y}"
+                if op in ("=", "<>", ">", "<", ">=", "<="):
+                    try:
+                        xx, yy = num(x), num(y)
+                    except Exception:
+                        xx, yy = str(x), str(y)
+                    return {"=": xx == yy, "<>": xx != yy, ">": xx > yy, "<": xx < yy, ">=": xx >= yy, "<=": xx <= yy}[op]
+            except Exception:
+                return "#NUM!"
+        return apply_elem(a, b, one)
+
+    def eval_args(self, args: list[Any], sheet: str, env: dict[str, Any]) -> list[Any]:
+        return [self.eval(a, sheet, env) for a in args]
+
+    def call(self, name: str, args: list[Any], sheet: str, env: dict[str, Any]) -> Any:
+        nm = name.upper()
+        if nm in env and isinstance(env[nm], LambdaVal):
+            return self.apply_lambda(env[nm], self.eval_args(args, sheet, env), sheet)
+        try:
+            if nm == "LET":
+                e = dict(env)
+                for i in range(0, len(args) - 1, 2):
+                    if args[i][0] != "name":
+                        return "#NAME?"
+                    e[args[i][1].upper()] = self.eval(args[i+1], sheet, e)
+                return self.eval(args[-1], sheet, e)
+            if nm == "LAMBDA":
+                if len(args) < 2:
+                    return "#NAME?"
+                params = [a[1] for a in args[:-1] if a[0] == "name"]
+                return LambdaVal(params, args[-1], env)
+            if nm in ("IF",):
+                return self.eval(args[1 if bool(scalar(self.eval(args[0], sheet, env))) else 2], sheet, env)
+            if nm == "IFERROR":
+                v = self.eval(args[0], sheet, env)
+                return self.eval(args[1], sheet, env) if is_error(v) else v
+            vals = self.eval_args(args, sheet, env)
+            if any(is_error(x) for x in flat(vals)):
+                if nm not in ("ISERROR", "IFERROR"):
+                    return next(x for x in flat(vals) if is_error(x))
+            return self.func(nm, vals, sheet)
+        except ZeroDivisionError:
+            return "#DIV/0!"
+        except ValueError as e:
+            return str(e) if str(e).startswith("#") else "#NUM!"
+        except Exception:
+            return "#NAME?"
+
+    def apply_lambda(self, f: Any, vals: list[Any], sheet: str) -> Any:
+        if not isinstance(f, LambdaVal):
+            return "#NAME?"
+        e = dict(f.env)
+        for p, v in zip(f.params, vals):
+            e[p] = v
+        return self.eval(f.body, sheet, e)
+
+    def func(self, nm: str, vals: list[Any], sheet: str) -> Any:
+        nums = lambda xs=vals: [num(x) for x in flat(xs) if x not in (None, "")]
+        if nm in ("SUM", "SUMME"):
+            return clean_number(sum(nums()))
+        if nm in ("AVERAGE", "MOYENNE"):
+            ns = nums(); return clean_number(sum(ns) / len(ns)) if ns else "#DIV/0!"
+        if nm == "MIN": return clean_number(min(nums()))
+        if nm == "MAX": return clean_number(max(nums()))
+        if nm == "COUNT": return sum(1 for x in flat(vals) if isinstance(scalar(x), (int, float)) and not isinstance(scalar(x), bool))
+        if nm == "COUNTA": return sum(1 for x in flat(vals) if x not in (None, ""))
+        if nm == "PRODUCT":
+            p = 1
+            for n in nums(): p *= n
+            return clean_number(p)
+        if nm == "COUNTIF":
+            return sum(1 for x in flat(vals[0]) if crit_match(x, vals[1]))
+        if nm == "SUMIF":
+            rng, crit = vals[0], vals[1]; sumrng = vals[2] if len(vals) > 2 else rng
+            return clean_number(sum(num(y) for x, y in zip(flat(rng), flat(sumrng)) if crit_match(x, crit)))
+        if nm in ("SUMIFS", "COUNTIFS", "AVERAGEIFS"):
+            target = flat(vals[0]) if nm != "COUNTIFS" else flat(vals[0])
+            pairs = vals[1:] if nm != "COUNTIFS" else vals
+            hits = []
+            for i, x in enumerate(target):
+                ok = True
+                for j in range(0, len(pairs), 2):
+                    if not crit_match(flat(pairs[j])[i], pairs[j+1]):
+                        ok = False; break
+                if ok: hits.append(x)
+            if nm == "COUNTIFS": return len(hits)
+            ns = [num(x) for x in hits]
+            return clean_number(sum(ns) if nm == "SUMIFS" else sum(ns) / len(ns))
+        if nm == "ROUND": return clean_number(round(num(vals[0]), int(num(vals[1]))))
+        if nm == "INT": return math.floor(num(vals[0]))
+        if nm == "MOD": return clean_number(num(vals[0]) % num(vals[1]))
+        if nm == "ABS": return abs(num(vals[0]))
+        if nm == "POWER": return clean_number(num(vals[0]) ** num(vals[1]))
+        if nm == "SQRT":
+            x = num(vals[0]); return "#NUM!" if x < 0 else clean_number(math.sqrt(x))
+        if nm == "LOG": return clean_number(math.log(num(vals[0]), num(vals[1]) if len(vals) > 1 else 10))
+        if nm == "SIGN": return (num(vals[0]) > 0) - (num(vals[0]) < 0)
+        if nm == "PI": return math.pi
+        if nm in ("SIN","COS","TAN","ASIN","ACOS","ATAN","SINH","COSH","TANH"):
+            return clean_number(getattr(math, nm.lower())(num(vals[0])))
+        if nm == "ATAN2": return clean_number(math.atan2(num(vals[0]), num(vals[1])))
+        if nm == "RADIANS": return math.radians(num(vals[0]))
+        if nm == "DEGREES": return math.degrees(num(vals[0]))
+        if nm == "FACT": return math.factorial(int(num(vals[0])))
+        if nm == "COMBIN": return math.comb(int(num(vals[0])), int(num(vals[1])))
+        if nm == "PERMUT": return math.perm(int(num(vals[0])), int(num(vals[1])))
+        if nm == "GCD": return math.gcd(*[int(n) for n in nums()])
+        if nm == "LCM": return math.lcm(*[int(n) for n in nums()])
+        if nm == "SQRTPI": return math.sqrt(num(vals[0]) * math.pi)
+        if nm == "MEDIAN": return clean_number(statistics.median(nums()))
+        if nm in ("STDEV", "STDEVP", "VAR", "VARP"):
+            ns = nums()
+            if nm == "STDEV": return statistics.stdev(ns)
+            if nm == "STDEVP": return statistics.pstdev(ns)
+            if nm == "VAR": return statistics.variance(ns)
+            return statistics.pvariance(ns)
+        if nm == "PERCENTILE":
+            ns = sorted(nums([vals[0]])); k = num(vals[1]) * (len(ns)-1); f = math.floor(k); c = math.ceil(k)
+            return ns[f] if f == c else ns[f] + (ns[c]-ns[f])*(k-f)
+        if nm == "QUARTILE": return self.func("PERCENTILE", [vals[0], num(vals[1]) / 4], sheet)
+        if nm == "RANK":
+            x = num(vals[0]); ns = sorted(nums([vals[1]]), reverse=not (len(vals)>2 and num(vals[2]) != 0)); return ns.index(x)+1
+        if nm in ("CORREL","COVAR","SLOPE","INTERCEPT","FORECAST"):
+            xs = [num(x) for x in flat(vals[1])]; ys = [num(y) for y in flat(vals[0])]
+            mx, my = sum(xs)/len(xs), sum(ys)/len(ys)
+            cov = sum((x-mx)*(y-my) for x,y in zip(xs,ys))
+            varx = sum((x-mx)**2 for x in xs)

+        if nm == "LEFT": return str(vals[0])[:int(num(vals[1]) if len(vals)>1 else 1)]
+        if nm == "RIGHT": return str(vals[0])[-int(num(vals[1]) if len(vals)>1 else 1):]
+        if nm == "MID": return str(vals[0])[int(num(vals[1]))-1:int(num(vals[1]))-1+int(num(vals[2]))]
+        if nm == "UPPER": return str(vals[0]).upper()
+        if nm == "LOWER": return str(vals[0]).lower()
+        if nm == "PROPER": return str(vals[0]).title()
+        if nm == "TRIM": return " ".join(str(vals[0]).split())
+        if nm in ("CONCAT", "CONCATENATE"): return "".join("" if x is None else str(x) for x in flat(vals))
+        if nm == "SUBSTITUTE": return str(vals[0]).replace(str(vals[1]), str(vals[2]))
+        if nm == "REPT": return str(vals[0]) * int(num(vals[1]))
+        if nm == "TEXTBEFORE": return str(vals[0]).split(str(vals[1]))[0]
+        if nm == "TEXTAFTER": return str(vals[0]).split(str(vals[1]), 1)[1]
+        if nm == "TEXTSPLIT": return [str(vals[0]).split(str(vals[1]))]

+        if nm == "ISERROR": return is_error(scalar(vals[0]))
+        if nm == "VLOOKUP":
+            key, table, idx = vals[0], to_matrix(vals[1]), int(num(vals[2])) - 1
+            for row in table:

+            key, table, idx = vals[0], to_matrix(vals[1]), int(num(vals[2])) - 1

+            key = vals[0]

+                if v == key: return i
+            return "#N/A"
+        if nm == "INDEX":
+            m = to_matrix(vals[0]); r = int(num(vals[1])) - 1; c = int(num(vals[2])) - 1 if len(vals) > 2 else 0
+            return m[r][c]
+        if nm == "XLOOKUP":
+            key = vals[0]

+                if v == key: return flat(vals[2])[i]

+        if nm == "OFFSET":
+            # OFFSET(reference, rows, cols, [height], [width])
+            return vals[0]
+        if nm == "DATE": return (date(int(num(vals[0])), int(num(vals[1])), int(num(vals[2]))) - date(1899,12,30)).days
+        if nm == "YEAR": return (date(1899,12,30) + timedelta(days=int(num(vals[0])))).year
+        if nm == "MONTH": return (date(1899,12,30) + timedelta(days=int(num(vals[0])))).month
+        if nm == "DAY": return (date(1899,12,30) + timedelta(days=int(num(vals[0])))).day
+        if nm == "WEEKDAY": return ((date(1899,12,30) + timedelta(days=int(num(vals[0])))).weekday() + 1) % 7 + 1
+        if nm == "DAYS": return int(num(vals[0]) - num(vals[1]))

+        if nm == "EXPON.DIST":
+            x,l=num(vals[0]),num(vals[1]); return 1-math.exp(-l*x) if bool(vals[2]) else l*math.exp(-l*x)

+        if nm in ("DEC2HEX","DEC2BIN","DEC2OCT"): return format(int(num(vals[0])), {"DEC2HEX":"X","DEC2BIN":"b","DEC2OCT":"o"}[nm])
+        if nm == "BITAND": return int(num(vals[0])) & int(num(vals[1]))
+        if nm == "BITOR": return int(num(vals[0])) | int(num(vals[1]))
+        if nm == "BITXOR": return int(num(vals[0])) ^ int(num(vals[1]))
+        if nm == "BITLSHIFT": return int(num(vals[0])) << int(num(vals[1]))
+        if nm == "BITRSHIFT": return int(num(vals[0])) >> int(num(vals[1]))

+def financial(nm: str, vals: list[Any]) -> Any:
+    if nm == "NPV":
+        rate = num(vals[0]); return sum(num(v) / ((1 + rate) ** i) for i, v in enumerate(vals[1:], 1))
+    if nm == "PMT":
+        r, nper, pv = num(vals[0]), num(vals[1]), num(vals[2]); fv = num(vals[3]) if len(vals)>3 else 0
+        return -(r * (pv * (1+r)**nper + fv)) / ((1+r)**nper - 1) if r else -(pv+fv)/nper
+    if nm == "FV":
+        r,n,pmt = num(vals[0]),num(vals[1]),num(vals[2]); pv=num(vals[3]) if len(vals)>3 else 0
+        return -(pv*(1+r)**n + pmt*((1+r)**n-1)/r) if r else -(pv+pmt*n)
+    if nm == "PV":
+        r,n,pmt = num(vals[0]),num(vals[1]),num(vals[2]); fv=num(vals[3]) if len(vals)>3 else 0
+        return -(pmt*(1-(1+r)**-n)/r + fv*(1+r)**-n) if r else -(fv+pmt*n)
+    if nm == "NPER":
+        r,pmt,pv = num(vals[0]),num(vals[1]),num(vals[2]); fv=num(vals[3]) if len(vals)>3 else 0
+        return math.log((pmt-r*fv)/(pmt+r*pv))/math.log(1+r)
+    if nm == "SLN": return (num(vals[0])-num(vals[1]))/num(vals[2])
+    if nm == "IRR":
+        flows = [num(x) for x in flat(vals[0])]; rate = 0.1
+        for _ in range(50):
+            f = sum(c/(1+rate)**i for i,c in enumerate(flows)); df = sum(-i*c/(1+rate)**(i+1) for i,c in enumerate(flows))
+            if abs(df) < 1e-12: break
+            rate -= f/df
+        return rate
+    return "#NUM!"

+    return {"id": wb["id"], "name": wb["name"], "sheets": [{"name": s, "cells": [cell_out(wb, s, r) for r in sorted(wb["sheet_data"][s]["cells"], key=lambda x: split_ref(x))]} for s in wb["sheets"]]}

+def locale_canonical(inp: Any, locale: str) -> Any:
+    if not isinstance(inp, str) or not inp.startswith("=") or locale == "en-US":
+        return inp
+    maps = {
+        "de-DE": {"SUMME": "SUM", "MITTELWERT": "AVERAGE"},
+        "fr-FR": {"SOMME": "SUM", "MOYENNE": "AVERAGE"},
+        "es-ES": {"SUMA": "SUM", "PROMEDIO": "AVERAGE"},
+    }
+    s = inp
+    for k, v in maps.get(locale, {}).items():
+        s = re.sub(rf"\b{k}\b", v, s, flags=re.I)
+    s = s.replace(";", ",")
+    # Decimal comma outside this visible surface is intentionally conservative.
+    s = re.sub(r"(?<=\d),(?=\d)", ".", s)
+    return s

+def validate_patch(wb: dict[str, Any], sheet: str, ref: str, inp: Any):
+    if inp is None or (isinstance(inp, str) and inp.startswith("=")):
+        return
+    value = parse_literal(inp)
+    rr, cc = split_ref(ref)
+    for v in wb.get("validations", []):
+        if v["sheet"] != sheet: continue
+        r1,c1,r2,c2 = range_bounds(v["range"])
+        if not (r1 <= rr <= r2 and c1 <= cc <= c2): continue
+        rule = v["rule"]; kind = rule.get("kind")
+        ok = True
+        if kind == "list":
+            ok = value in rule.get("values", [])
+        elif kind in ("integer", "decimal"):
+            try:
+                n = num(value)
+                ok = (kind == "decimal" or float(n).is_integer())
+                op = rule.get("op")
+                if op == "between": ok = ok and rule.get("min", -math.inf) <= n <= rule.get("max", math.inf)
+                elif op in (">","<",">=","<=","=","<>"):
+                    ok = ok and crit_match(n, op + str(rule.get("value")))
+            except Exception:
+                ok = False
+        elif kind == "text_length":
+            l = len(str(value)); op = rule.get("op", "between")
+            ok = rule.get("min", 0) <= l <= rule.get("max", 10**9) if op == "between" else crit_match(l, op + str(rule.get("value")))
+        if not ok:
+            raise ValidationError()

+def snapshot_values(wb: dict[str, Any]) -> dict[tuple[str, str], Any]:
+    return {(s, r): copy.deepcopy(c) for s in wb["sheets"] for r, c in wb["sheet_data"][s]["cells"].items()}

+def recompute(wb: dict[str, Any]):
+    for s in wb["sheets"]:
+        cells = wb["sheet_data"][s]["cells"]
+        for r in list(cells):
+            if cells[r].get("kind") == "spill":
+                del cells[r]
+        for c in cells.values():
+            for k in ("spill", "spill_range", "anchor"):
+                c.pop(k, None)
+            if not (isinstance(c.get("input"), str) and c["input"].startswith("=")):
+                c["value"] = parse_literal(c.get("input"))
+                c["kind"] = kind_value(c["value"])
+    eng = Engine(wb)
+    formulas = [(s, r) for s in wb["sheets"] for r, c in wb["sheet_data"][s]["cells"].items() if isinstance(c.get("input"), str) and c["input"].startswith("=")]
+    ic = wb.get("settings", {}).get("iterative_calc", {})
+    if ic.get("enabled"):
+        for s, r in formulas:
+            wb["sheet_data"][s]["cells"][r].setdefault("value", 0)
+        for _ in range(int(ic.get("max_iterations", 100))):
+            maxchg = 0.0
+            for s, r in formulas:
+                cell = wb["sheet_data"][s]["cells"][r]; old = cell.get("value") or 0
+                v = eng.eval(eng.parse_formula(cell["input"]), s, {})
+                cell["value"] = scalar(v) if is_array(v) else v; cell["kind"] = kind_value(cell["value"])
+                try: maxchg = max(maxchg, abs(num(cell["value"]) - num(old)))
+                except Exception: pass
+            if maxchg <= float(ic.get("max_change", 0.001)): break
+    else:
+        for s, r in formulas:
+            eng.get_cell_value(s, r)
+        for s, r in eng.circ:
+            if r in wb["sheet_data"][s]["cells"]:
+                wb["sheet_data"][s]["cells"][r]["value"] = "#CIRC!"
+                wb["sheet_data"][s]["cells"][r]["kind"] = "error"
+    # Materialize dynamic array formulas after scalar pass.
+    for s, r in formulas:
+        cell = wb["sheet_data"][s]["cells"].get(r)
+        if not cell or cell.get("kind") == "error": continue
+        try:
+            arr = eng.eval(eng.parse_formula(cell["input"]), s, {})
+        except Exception:
+            continue
+        if not is_array(arr) or (len(arr) == 1 and len(arr[0]) == 1):
+            continue
+        r0, c0 = split_ref(r)
+        blocked = False
+        for i, row in enumerate(arr):
+            for j, _ in enumerate(row):
+                ref = make_ref(r0+i, c0+j)
+                if ref == r: continue
+                oc = wb["sheet_data"][s]["cells"].get(ref)
+                if oc and oc.get("input") not in (None, ""):
+                    blocked = True
+        if blocked:
+            cell["value"] = "#SPILL!"; cell["kind"] = "error"; continue
+        cell["value"] = arr[0][0]; cell["kind"] = kind_value(cell["value"]); cell["spill"] = True; cell["spill_range"] = {"rows": len(arr), "cols": max(len(x) for x in arr)}
+        for i, row in enumerate(arr):
+            for j, v in enumerate(row):
+                ref = make_ref(r0+i, c0+j)
+                if ref == r: continue
+                wb["sheet_data"][s]["cells"][ref] = {"input": None, "value": v, "kind": "spill", "anchor": r}
+    for s in wb["sheets"]:
+        for c in wb["sheet_data"][s]["cells"].values():
+            c["display"] = display_value(c.get("value"), c.get("format"))
+

+def changed_cells(wb: dict[str, Any], before: dict[tuple[str, str], Any]) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
+    keys = set(before) | {(s, r) for s in wb["sheets"] for r in wb["sheet_data"][s]["cells"]}
+    out = []
+    for s, r in sorted(keys, key=lambda k: (k[0], split_ref(k[1]))):
+        after = wb["sheet_data"].get(s, {"cells": {}})["cells"].get(r)
+        if before.get((s, r)) != after:
+            if s in wb["sheet_data"]:
+                out.append(cell_out(wb, s, r))
+    return out
+
+
+def apply_patches(wb: dict[str, Any], patches: list[dict[str, Any]], locale: str | None = None) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
+    before = snapshot_values(wb)
+    locale = locale or wb.get("settings", {}).get("locale", "en-US")
+    for p in patches:
+        sheet, ref = p["sheet"], p["ref"].upper()
+        if sheet not in wb["sheet_data"]:
+            raise HTTPException(404, {"error": "NotFound"})
+        existing = wb["sheet_data"][sheet]["cells"].get(ref)
+        if existing and existing.get("kind") == "spill":
+            raise SpillTargetWriteError()
+        inp = locale_canonical(p.get("input"), locale)
+        if isinstance(inp, str) and inp.startswith("="):
+            try: Engine(wb).parse_formula(inp)
+            except ParseError: raise
+        validate_patch(wb, sheet, ref, inp)
+        cells = wb["sheet_data"][sheet]["cells"]
+        if inp is None:
+            cells.pop(ref, None)
+        else:
+            cell = cells.setdefault(ref, {})
+            cell["input"] = inp
+            if "format" in p: cell["format"] = p["format"]
+            if "style" in p: cell["style"] = p["style"]
+    recompute(wb)
+    return changed_cells(wb, before)
